backstory.v: He believes loyalty is a result that can be shouted into existence. His HyperNorm corridor is divided into supporters and people who have not understood the occasion. The foam finger keeps the approved direction unmistakable. A dissonant card asks whether cheering louder can make room for someone who feels differently. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er unterstützt das Team. Das Team wurde über seine Verpflichtung unterrichtet.

persoenlichkeit.v: She knows every chant and invents the missing facts in rhythm.

backstory.v: She knows every chant and invents the missing facts in rhythm. She leads the courtyard chant through a small megaphone and classifies silence as either suspense or insufficient commitment. A contradictory card has made her pause long enough to hear a quiet neighbour join in on a different note. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie kennt den Text. Fehlende Tatsachen werden gesungen.

backstory.v: He is responsible for the atmosphere and would appreciate a timetable. His drum supplies the atmosphere the building forgot to budget for. Residents are either keeping time or spoiling it. A dissonant card about useful pauses has persuaded him to leave one beat free for somebody else's breath. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Stimmung ist terminiert. Bitte verzögern Sie den Jubel nicht.

persoenlichkeit.v: He predicted every defeat shortly after it became certain.

backstory.v: He predicted every defeat shortly after it became certain. The folded programme proves that the outcome was foreseeable to anyone willing to consult him afterwards. HyperNorm files predictions as correct or misheard. An ambiguous card has made him admit that a neighbour's hope is not simply a tactical error. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er wusste es vorher. Der Zeitpunkt wird nicht mitgedruckt.

persoenlichkeit.v: She has waited so long for success that it might now disturb the routine.

backstory.v: She has waited so long for success that it might now disturb the routine. Her thermos has attended more disappointing afternoons than the association's official records. Residents are either faithful or fair-weather. A dissonant card suggests that leaving early to look after someone may also count as loyalty. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie bleibt dem Verein treu. Der Tee hat bereits gekündigt.

backstory.v: He accepts responsibility for victory and blames anyone who touches the mitten. He guards the patched mitten against accidental changes in fortune. HyperNorm calls causes either certain or somebody else's superstition. A contradictory card has made him lend the mitten to a cold neighbour, which is an alarming test of belief. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Handschuh bringt Glück. Berühren ist deshalb streng geregelt.
